def call(endpoint, data):
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://slack.com/api/" + endpoint,
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        return json.load(r)

# 1. Find Diego Alvarez's user id

    if "diego" in rn.lower() and "alvarez" in rn.lower() and not u.get("deleted"):
        diego = u
        break

        text = m.get("text", "").lower()
        if "meridian" in text and "deadline" in text:
            found = m

if not found:
